caption: The video showcases a macro underwater view of several bright yellow lemon wedges arranged diagonally across a dark liquid background. The wedge faces are densely coated with tiny adhering micro-bubbles, while scattered larger spherical bubbles cling along the edges and surfaces. The wedges remain largely fixed in position and orientation, with no obvious translation or rotation. The fine bubble coating persists, with its dense tiny bubbles appearing largely stable. Larger bubbles on the edges remain mostly attached and steady, while a few out-of-focus free bubbles in the lower-left dark region drift slowly upward through the liquid. The bubbling is already underway. It continues steadily without resolving into a completed event.
relations: Fixed lemon wedges in dark liquid -> dense tiny micro-bubbles persist adhering to faces.
Larger spherical bubbles on wedge edges -> remain mostly attached and steady.
Free bubbles in lower-left dark region -> drift slowly upward through liquid.
Ongoing bubbling process -> continues steadily without resolving into a completed event.
